name: Port Pirie Mural Trail
reason: Tourism board lists a 2 km, map-guided mural walk through Port Pirie's centre (30+ min to a couple of hours), permanent and open.

name: Port Pirie Heritage Trail
reason: Tourism board lists a self-guided heritage trail of 30+ sites including the Smelter, a named guide walking route; cars or foot.

name: Port Augusta Wharf Precinct
reason: Wikivoyage says the wharf view is hidden behind a supermarket and it is only a recreational precinct; nothing named to see or do for half an hour. Only one source.

name: Blanche Harbor
reason: Wikivoyage names Blanche Harbor as a rehabilitated coastal picnic and birdwatching spot (mulga parrots, emus); second-tier natural stop, open access.

name: Port Augusta Foreshore
reason: Wikivoyage names the foreshore beach with a jetty into deep water, showers and change rooms for swimming; a named beach/jetty stop.

name: Town Carriage Museum (Peterborough)
reason: Two counted sources: Wikivoyage Peterborough See listing and the 4-day Southern Flinders itinerary; open railway carriage museum.

name: Glenholme Vineyards (Blesing's Garden)
reason: Cellar door, a business; one itinerary mention only.

name: Wirrabara Silo Art
reason: Itinerary names the Wirrabara silo art as a roadside art icon people stop to photograph; permanent, open. Short stop but a quirky icon.

name: Jarvis Hill Lookout and Walking Trail
reason: Tourism board listing: popular lookout and walking trail near Hawker with views to Wilpena Pound; permanent and free. Dirt road unsuitable when wet.

name: Camel Hump Lookout Walk
reason: Tourism board listing: easy short climb with panoramic views just south of Hawker; named walk, permanent and free.

name: Castle Rock Walk and Lookout
reason: Tourism board listing: castle-shaped rock with a walking track and lookout east of Hawker; named walk, permanent and free.

name: Ferguson Gorge Scenic Drive and Bush Walk
reason: Tourism board listing: scenic drive through Hannigans Gap and 1.6 km walk to a gorge with rock pools and yellow-footed rock-wallabies; 4-5 hours, open to day visitors for a per-vehicle fee (private station land, but access sold to the public).

name: Red Bridge
reason: For: tourism board lists the 1882 Red Bridge on Pekina Creek as a railway landmark with a car park and creek setting. Against: one source, a bridge seen in about 10 minutes, little to do.

name: Fred Teague's Museum
reason: Tourism board lists a compact open museum of minerals, gemstones and fossils at Hawker Motors; indoor visit of 30+ min.

name: Aboriginal Carvings
reason: Tourism board lists Pekina Creek rock carvings as a significant cultural heritage site on a short creek walk from Orroroo's main street; open and free.

name: Adnyamathanha Dreaming Hawker Mural Walking Trail
reason: Tourism board lists a self-guided mural walking tour of Adnyamathanha Dreaming stories with dual-language labels; permanent and open.

name: Buckaringa Sanctuary
reason: AWC sanctuary: AWC's own page gives no visitor arrangements and the Heysen Trail route there has been closed for feral-animal control; no public visit or counted visitor source found (searched AWC, web search, ExplorOz).

name: Horrocks Pass
reason: Wilmington town page and aussietowns name Horrocks Pass with its summit lookout and Horrocks monument, plus Hancocks Lookout views to Spencer Gulf; Heysen Trail passes the monument. Marginal short stop but a guide names it.

name: Kanalla Falls
reason: No counted visitor source found (searched web, Wikipedia only); a waterfall inside Ikara-Flinders Ranges National Park, part of the larger park spot, flows only after rain.

name: Mount Serle
reason: No counted source found after searching; a peak on a pastoral station with no visitor page.

name: Mount Hack
reason: No counted source found; the summit lies on the Warraweena property reached only by 4WD track via the station, not a public visit page.

name: Mount Gee
reason: No counted source found after searching; remote peak in the Arkaroola area, not a named visitor stop.

name: Baroota Dam
reason: A water reservoir; no counted visitor source found.

name: Moolawatana Station
reason: A working pastoral station; no counted visitor source and no public visit.

name: Wooltana Station
reason: A working pastoral station; no counted visitor source and no public visit.

name: Willochra Creek
reason: A creek; no counted visitor source naming it as a place to go.
